findings.explanation: The district name is recast as a city and changes the settlement hierarchy within Fuyuki.

findings.highlight: we should at least do whatever we want today
findings.evidenceJa: 今日ぐらいは好きなコトをしてもいいだろ
findings.governingReading: today of all days, Saber may do what she likes
findings.explanation: Shirou’s invitation for Saber to choose is changed into a joint license for both of them.

findings.evidenceJa: こう[ruby text=つらつら char=2]連々と文句を言いだす
findings.governingReading: starts reeling off complaints at length like this
findings.explanation: The reading and sustained flow of Saber’s lecture are reduced to an unspecified single complaint.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の見積もりの甘さ
findings.governingReading: the softness or overoptimism of your estimates
findings.explanation: Saber criticizes Shirou’s habit of underestimating costs; the English changes this to having no plan at all.

findings.evidenceJa: 正面からセイバーを見据える
findings.governingReading: He fixes Saber with a direct, unwavering look.
findings.explanation: The force and confrontational directness of his gaze disappear.

findings.highlight: I won’t have to worry about making you unhappy if you do so.
findings.evidenceJa: その方がお互い気兼ねしなくて済む
findings.governingReading: That way neither of them will need to hold back around the other.
findings.explanation: Mutual freedom from reserve becomes Shirou’s one-sided anxiety about upsetting Saber.

findings.highlight: averts her gaze and runs out of words
findings.evidenceJa: 視線を泳がせて言葉を濁す
findings.governingReading: her gaze wanders and she equivocates
findings.explanation: Saber’s uncharacteristic evasiveness becomes a simple inability to continue speaking.

findings.highlight: I just have to take her to every possible place I can think of.
findings.evidenceJa: あとは思いつくかぎりのエスコートをするだけだ
findings.governingReading: All that remains is to escort her as well as he can think how.
findings.explanation: The social role and conduct of escorting Saber are changed into maximizing the number of destinations.

findings.highlight: We also went to an antique store
findings.evidenceJa: 趣味で骨董品屋に立ち寄ったのはご愛敬だし
findings.governingReading: His self-indulgent stop at an antique shop can be forgiven as a charming lapse.
findings.explanation: The English lists the stop without admitting it served Shirou’s own hobby or preserving his comic plea for indulgence.
The establishment’s category changes from a café or coffee shop to a restaurant.

findings.evidenceJa: 今日はひどく緊張したので
findings.governingReading: because she has been terribly tense today
findings.explanation: Saber identifies sustained tension as the cause of unusual fatigue; the English replaces that cause with a generally exhausting day.

findings.evidenceJa: むーっとヘソを曲げてしまった
findings.governingReading: Saber went into a pout or sulk
findings.explanation: Her childish, comic displeasure at attracting attention becomes generic anger.

findings.highlight: I also know her attitude after she lets go of her sword.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が知っているのは、剣を手にした後の彼女でしかない
findings.governingReading: The only Saber he has known is her after she took the sword in hand.
findings.explanation: The English reverses taking up the sword into letting it go and changes an exclusivity claim into additional knowledge.

findings.highlight: it’s abnormal for her to hold a sword at all
findings.evidenceJa: むしろ剣を持っている方が、この少女には異常な事なのかもしれない
findings.governingReading: Perhaps it is instead the act of holding a sword that is abnormal for this girl.
findings.explanation: A possibility framed through Shirou’s reflection becomes an unqualified absolute judgment.
